task.title: Check status of current NodeMaintenance CR tasks
task.shortdesc: You can check the status of current NodeMaintenance CR tasks.

ul.li: Install the Red Hat OpenShift CLI oc.
Log in as a user with cluster-admin privileges.

step.cmd: Check the status of current node maintenance tasks, for example the NodeMaintenance CR or nm object, by running the following command:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: v1 items: - apiVersion: nodemaintenance.medik8s.io/v1beta1 kind: NodeMaintenance metadata: ... spec: nodeName: node-1.example.com reason: Node maintenance status: drainProgress: 100 evictionPods: 3 lastError: "Last failure message" lastUpdate: "2022-06-23T11:43:18Z" phase: Succeeded totalpods: 5 ...

step.cmd: drainProgress: The percentage completion of draining the node.
evictionPods: The number of pods scheduled for eviction.
lastError: The latest eviction error, if any.
lastUpdate: The last time the status was updated.
totalpods: The total number of pods before the node entered maintenance mode.
